findings.narrativeExcerpt: 42,4 van de 605,6 quadriljoen Btu totale energieproductie
findings.evidenceExcerpt: Across all energy production, renewables were 42.4 out of 605.6 quadrillion Btu, reported as 7%.
findings.explanation: The Dutch “quadriljoen” means 10^24, while the source’s English “quadrillion” means 10^15. This changes the stated quantities by a factor of a billion; standard Dutch terminology for 10^15 is “biljard.”

rationale: The blueprint is aligned, clearly progressed, actionable, and ends on a source-supported distinction; the unit-scale translation error materially compromises its factual details.
